label.purpose: Category labels, state labels, and compact metadata.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The coral action used for the next meaningful step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--coral-dark, #b94d49); border-radius: 0; background: var(--coral, #e9655e); color: #fffaf7; font: 800 14px/1.2 var(--font-body, sans-serif); transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--coral-dark, #b94d49); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #e9655e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A bordered secondary action that inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #17252c); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #17252c); font: 800 14px/1.2 var(--font-body, sans-serif); transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--ink, #17252c); color: var(--paper, #f3eee5); } .ds-button-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #e9655e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: A flat, bordered paper plane for grouped content.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5ccc0); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #17252c); } .ds-card strong { display: block; font: 600 20px/1.2 var(--font-display, sans-serif); } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-muted, #617077); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A substantial square field for puzzle answers.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 52px; padding: 8px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5ccc0); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #17252c); font: 700 16px/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--coral, #e9655e); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e9655e) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Difficulty Badge
components.description: A compact flat label for puzzle metadata.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: var(--mint, #dcebe3); color: var(--ink, #17252c); font: 800 11px/1.2 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A quiet navigation item with a flat active plane.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--ink-muted, #617077); font: 800 14px/1.2 var(--font-body, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--mint, #dcebe3); color: var(--ink, #17252c); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--surface, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #17252c); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #e9655e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Puzzle Type Glyph
components.description: The compact colour-coded mark that identifies a puzzle family.
components.css: .ds-type-glyph { position: relative; display: grid; width: 56px; height: 56px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5ccc0); border-radius: 0; background: var(--blue, #dcebf1); color: var(--ink, #17252c); } .ds-type-glyph strong { font: 600 18px/1 var(--font-display, sans-serif); } .ds-type-glyph svg { position: absolute; right: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 11px; height: 11px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.4; opacity: 0.45; }

narrative.overview:
Puzzie feels like a well-made puzzle sheet laid out on a warm desk: direct, tactile, and inviting without being childish. The system uses a warm paper ground, dark ink, a coral action colour, and small blocks of mint, sun, lavender, and blue to distinguish puzzle types and progress states.

The visual language is crisp and editorial. Strong alignment, square corners, one-pixel borders, and flat colour fields establish hierarchy without relying on shadows or decorative effects. Purposeful motion makes the puzzle sheet feel handled: a featured tile settles into place, navigation maintains continuity, and feedback responds directly to the action that caused it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with dark ink contrast.
Distinctive Space Grotesk display type paired with readable DM Sans body copy.
Flat colour accents with border-led, shadow-free depth.
CSS-only motion that explains arrival, selection, feedback, and completion.

rules.name: The Puzzle-in-Hand Rule
rules.body: Motion should feel like arranging paper pieces on a desk: short, direct, and tied to a meaningful state change.

rules.name: The Signal Colour Rule
rules.body: Coral is reserved for actions and meaningful emphasis; do not turn every surface into an accent.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk carries hierarchy and personality; DM Sans carries reading and interaction. Do not add another family without a role the two cannot perform.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Use borders, contrast, spacing, and overlap for depth. Do not add shadows, gradients, glass, or blur.

dos: Do keep all UI corners square and consistent.
Do use Space Grotesk for display roles and DM Sans for reading roles.
Do keep body copy readable and limit prose to a comfortable measure.
Do use flat colour fields, borders, spacing, and overlap to create hierarchy.
Do reserve authored motion for navigation, state feedback, completion, and the featured home puzzle.
Do keep success, error, disabled, and focus states explicit and accessible.
donts: Don't reintroduce rounded cards, pills, or shadows.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, decorative blur, or looping ornamental motion.
Don't animate layout dimensions when a transform can communicate the same relationship.
Don't use colour alone to communicate puzzle state.
Don't substitute emoji or arbitrary glyphs for the existing SVG icon language.
Don't add display font weights that are not loaded through next/font.
